master_plan_principles_consumed.principle_text: Dashboard contracts may be schema-only before runtime receipts and must not create a running dashboard, endpoint, login flow, or runtime state.
Owner approval receipt boundaries are non-delegable and must not authorize order execution, runtime cash claims, or launch.

Owner override may satisfy internal QTT workflow policy only and may not fabricate external facts, accepted source packets, connector semantics, runtime cash, order/fill receipts, replay/paper results, backend outputs, profit, or advantage evidence.
Dashboard or Telegram owner commands may not rewrite runtime facts, runtime cash receipts, order/fill receipts, or market data facts.
Static PRs may not create AtomicRows bundle or bundle digest files unless explicitly authorized.
Quantum optimizers may assist ranking and candidate refinement but remain outside live order submission and may not bypass source, connector, cash, owner, risk, or router gates.
Menu metadata for live use must not create live eligibility, canary eligibility, executable order intent, live routing, or order submission.
Static planning artifacts may not claim profit improvement, latency improvement, execution superiority, live readiness, backend readiness, or quantum advantage.
